name: Schönbrunn Palace
description: Habsburg summer palace with formal gardens and a hilltop Gloriette overlooking Vienna.

name: St. Stephen’s Cathedral
description: Vienna’s Gothic cathedral with a patterned roof and south tower climb over Stephansplatz.

name: Hofburg
description: The imperial palace complex holds museums, the Spanish Riding School and presidential offices.

name: Hohenwerfen Castle
description: A hilltop fortress above the Salzach valley, often paired with nearby ice-cave visits.

name: Melk Abbey
description: A baroque Benedictine abbey overlooks the Danube on the Wachau stretch.

name: Hallstatt
description: A lakeside village of Alpine houses mirrored in Hallstätter See. Paths climb to salt-mine views.

name: Salzburg Old Town
description: Baroque squares and fortress views fill Mozart’s birthplace city.

name: Nordkette
description: Cable cars rise from Innsbruck to Alpine ridges overlooking the Inn valley.

name: Wachau Valley
description: Vineyard terraces and Danube villages between Melk and Krems.

name: Krimml Waterfalls
description: A high cascade series in Hohe Tauern National Park with stepped viewing paths.

name: Naschmarkt
description: Vienna’s large outdoor market sells produce, spices and international street food.

name: Café Central
description: A grand café under vaulted ceilings in the Innere Stadt, known for cakes and coffeehouse culture.

name: Grünmarkt Salzburg
description: An open market by Universitätsplatz sells cheese, bread and mountain produce.

name: Linzer Bauernmarkt
description: Regional farmers’ stalls gather in Linz for produce and Linzer Torte cafés nearby.

name: Kaiser-Josef-Platz market
description: Graz’s long-running farmers’ market fills a central square with Styrian products.

name: Salzburg Festival
description: A summer festival of opera, drama and concerts across historic venues in Salzburg.
